name: keka
description: Memory for Claude Code: a session brief that compounds, automatic session-end learnings, /recall search, team handoff over git with a trust roster, and a /partners catalog of recommended companion tools. Zero runtime dependencies.

brief_chars.title: Session brief size (chars)
brief_chars.description: Max characters of memory injected at session start. The DB is unbounded; this caps only the auto-injected brief.

learn.title: Session-end learning compression
learn.description: One Haiku call per session distills a summary and 0-3 durable learnings into memory. Requires `claude` on PATH.

partners.title: Partner tool recommendations
partners.description: ask: /partners recommends, you pick what installs. auto: a missing partner may be installed when a task needs it (you are told each time). off: silence.
